import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    res = 0
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j + 1 < n and s[j] == s[j + 1]:
            j += 1
        length = j - i + 1
        if length % 2 == 0:
            res += 1
        i = j + 1
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
